conviction_note: Nothing unpriced found: the Q3 numbers are not pre-released and AQ gives no guidance, so the size is set by the name's own observed print reactions (median |move| about 6% over nine verified report days) and the stage's 7% base for new numbers; the slight negative lean comes from a bar that brokers raised into a record-high, above-target share price after a +11% 20-day run-up, against an easy year-ago comparison that is already in those estimates. p_up 47 x abs 7.0 gives -0.42; the findings sum to -1.0 because the valuation/bar finding is the only one with real weight, and both numbers agree in sign.

findings.finding: The bar was raised into the print and the stock sits above it: Handelsbanken (target 243, hold, 'valuation somewhat high', EV/EBIT 22x 2026e), Nordea (226, hold, 'much of the upside already reflected' at 18x EV/EBIT 2027), DNB Carnegie (233, hold) and SB1 (285, buy) all raised targets or estimates between 30 Sep and 7 Oct, and the share is at a record SEK 243 - above every target but SB1's - after +11.4% in 20 days and ~+25% year to date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Verified report days: Q2 2026 (organic 9%, record quarter) +11.28%; Q1 2026 (organic 6%, below the 10% target, US/Mexico cable-factory issues) -6.03%; Q4 2025 -5.63%; Q3 2025 +3.51%. The stock has punished growth misses and rewarded beats by similar amounts.
findings.original_quote: I en färsk analys skriver Handelsbanken att man väntar sig ytterligare ett kvartal med stark organisk tillväxt, där bankens prognos är 9,5 procent med en EBIT-marginal på 9,8 procent. ... "Efter våra prognosrevideringar handlas AQ till EV/EBIT på 22 gånger för 2026e". (Handelsbanken expects another quarter of strong organic growth, 9.5%, with a 9.8% EBIT margin ... 'after our forecast revisions AQ trades at 22x EV/EBIT 2026e'.)
findings.why_not_priced: This IS mostly priced - it is the description of what is priced. What it adds is the asymmetry: if the market were sceptical of Q3 the share would not be at a record above three of four targets with the brokers' raised numbers as the bar; an in-line print against estimates already lifted twice has less room to re-rate than Q2 did from SEK 202.
findings.independence: Nordea, separate source and broker: https://www.placera.se/telegram/aq-group-nordea-upprepar-behall-pa-aq-group--hojer-riktkursen-20260930 ; DNB Carnegie and SB1 target raises: https://www.placera.se/telegram/aq-group-dnb-carnegie-hojer-riktkursen-till-233-kr-220-20261007 , https://www.placera.se/telegram/aq-group-sb1-markets-hojer-riktkursen-till-285-kr-258-20261007

findings.finding: The year-ago comparison is easy: Q3 2025 organic growth was only 5% and its EBT margin of 8.8% was cut 0.7pp by mdexx, which the company said had reached break-even at EBT level by September 2025 - so a mechanical margin tailwind of up to ~0.7pp sits in Q3 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin surprise drove Q2 2026 (EBIT +17% on sales +10%; stock +11.28%); Q1 2026 margin up but growth weak, stock -6.03% - growth has mattered more than margin.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it has been public for a year and Handelsbanken's 9.8% EBIT margin (vs 9.0% a year ago) already embeds it, so it lands inside the bar; kept at a token size because a sequential margin read (Q2 EBIT margin 9.9%) suggests the bar is not stretched on margin.
findings.independence: Handelsbanken's margin forecast implies the same uplift: https://efn.se/kursrusaren-pa-rekordniva-shb-hojer-riktkursen

findings.finding: Q2 was end-loaded and built working capital: the CEO wrote that 'a large proportion of deliveries and invoicing took place at the end of the quarter' and operating cash flow fell to SEK 23m (232) on inventory and receivables - receivables should convert in Q3, but Q3 is 'as usual AQ's seasonally worst quarter', so sequential sales momentum and the cash comparison against Q3 2025's SEK 322m are both at risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026's weak cash flow (SEK 23m) did not stop a +11.28% day; cash has not been the line this stock trades on so far.
findings.why_not_priced: The brokers' previews quoted are about organic growth and margin; none sourced here mentions Q3 cash flow or the Q2 timing effect. If the market had priced a sequential dip the bar would not have been raised to 9.5-10% organic in the final fortnight.
findings.independence: Seasonality stated separately in the Q3 2025 report: https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b80caa6186c928833669c0ff9218c5756&lang=en&src=listed (same issuer, different document)

findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed history of insider prints moving AQ.

findings.why_not_priced: Public in FI's insider register but small and unreported in the press; a meaningful sale ahead of a weak quarter would show as more than one holder or a larger block, which it does not - hence a token size.

findings.finding: The Norlake asset acquisition (USD 7m revenue at below-group profitability, closed 21 Sept) contributes about one week to Q3, so its effect on the quarter is negligible; any acquisition cost or purchase-price gain is a below-the-line one-off.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Acquisitions have not been the line AQ prints trade on.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced: Nordea raised 2026-28 EBIT forecasts 1-3% on it on 30 Sept; Q3 effect is about 0.1% of sales.

language_note: The Q3 bar exists only in Swedish press: Handelsbanken's 9.5% organic / 9.8% EBIT margin forecast (EFN) and Nordea's 10% organic (Finwire on Placera); no English source carried a Q3 estimate.
The four broker target moves of 30 Sep - 7 Oct came from Swedish wire telegrams (Nyhetsbyrån Direkt, Finwire); English aggregators still showed a July consensus target of SEK 218.
The insider sales came from FI's Swedish-language insider register.
Company releases (reports, targets, Norlake, invitations) were bilingual and identical; the Swedish versions added nothing.
lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding': the Q3 cash-release (+0.3) and Q2 end-loaded-invoicing (-0.4) findings both rested on the Q2 report's working-capital statement; merged into one at -0.2.

'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' / look at working capital: the merged cash finding no longer leans positive, since growth and capacity investment can keep working capital high against a SEK 322m comparison.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the mdexx easy-comparison finding was cut from +0.3 to +0.1, because it has been public since Oct 2025 and is inside Handelsbanken's 9.8% margin.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 6.5 to 7.0 (numbers new, no guide; the name's own verified print median is about 6%, with an 11% move last time).
